component.name: AgyMolden
component.summary: Molden-inspired 3D Z-matrix molecular builder & quantum chemistry workflow cockpit

description.p: AgyMolden is a high-performance, modern native Linux molecular modeling suite and quantum chemistry workbench. It merges classic Molden-style internal coordinate editing (Z-matrices) with contemporary interactive 3D mechanics.

ul.li: Interactive 3D OpenGL Viewport with real-time Z-Matrix synchronization and elastic bond dragging.
Universal multi-engine quantum chemistry execution: ORCA, Gaussian, Psi4, PySCF, and xTB.
QC Doctor™ Automated Error Diagnostics: Instant pattern matching and 1-click automatic remediation for SCF convergence and trust-radius collapses.
Real-Space Wavefunction & Surface Analysis: 3D MOs, Electrostatic Potential (ESP), NCI/RDG, ELF, and 2D planar contour slices.
Multi-format interoperability: XYZ, PDB, SDF/MOL, Tripos Mol2, CIF, Gaussian .fchk/.cube, Molden, and compressed .agyproj session bundles.
Publication Supporting Information (SI) Generator: 1-click LaTeX table and coordinate export.
QC Doctor™ 1-click auto-fix for ORCA, Gaussian, and Psi4.
Crystallographic CIF and Tripos Mol2 format support.
Portable session bundles (.agyproj) and 60s crash-recovery autosave.
